title: Kagamine Len — An Intriguing Exhibition〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena said she'd be going over to help set up that exhibit, so I think he's excited to see what it's like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll probably be helping set everything up in the morning. Rin, Len, you two can come over whenever during that time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Ena said she'd be there in the morning to help set up...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(But what time did she mean?
Is it okay for us to go see her now...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (B-But there's also a chance that she's still asleep... I'd rather not wake her...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh... S-Sorry...
I'm just excited about seeing Ena and that exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I don't think Ena's woken up yet...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you're that excited, then why don't you draw some pictures in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That should help take your mind off things.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, I'll draw while we wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I promised to show Ena my picture.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... So, I'll draw with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Let's see... Mizuki's hair is all pink and curly... And Ena's hair is...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...? Where'd the brown crayon go...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay. Can I use it once you're done...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Time usually flies by so fast whenever I draw...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But today, each second feels so long for some reason. Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Is it still too early for us to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Again, Len, you really need to relax...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've made hardly any progress on your picture. Why don't you take a deep breath...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you've been coloring the same spot for a little while now, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was trying to make it look better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway, I think we can head over now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
To see Ena.
I'm sure she's awake now since she said she'd be heading over in the morning. Also...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If she's still asleep, then it's her fault for not waking up on time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I don't think Ena's woken up yet...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... If she is still asleep, then I'd feel really bad about waking her up...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I believe Ena is going to be fine.
Anyway, you need to go before Rin leaves you behind.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see what this exhibit is like...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (A big hall with lots of paintings... I'm so excited...!)
